The information is general

The pages and articles here explain how company setup and government procedures usually work in Qatar. They are meant to help you understand the process. They are not legal, tax or financial advice. Rules, fees and processing times are set by the authorities and they change. Before you act, ask us to confirm what applies to your case, or speak to a lawyer or tax adviser.

We are a service company

Primeway prepares and submits applications to government bodies on behalf of clients. We do not control whether an authority approves an application, and we cannot promise a result or a date. Fees charged by the government are paid to the government. Our own fee is shown separately in the quote.
